# Kay Joy Flowers

> Author and educator Kay Joy Flowers (born in Cape Town, South Africa; lives in New Zealand; 35+ years in education) writes books and embodied practices for women who know there's more to them: self-trust, nervous-system steadiness and personal sovereignty. Her body of work is called A Living Cosmology of Remembrance. Her flagship book is Fearlessly Unfuckwithable.

## Books and offers

- [Fearlessly Unfuckwithable](https://kayjoyflowers.online/fearlessly-unfuckwithable.html): The flagship book (digital, US$33) and the Sovereignty Bundle (US$77): the book, the 7-Day Survival to Sovereignty Reset and Journal, the FU Somatic Arsenal (ten body-first practices) and the Unfuckwithable Companion.
- [Genius Insight energetic scans](https://kayjoyflowers.online/genius-insight.html): Remote energetic scans by distance from a photo and voice recording. One-off scan US$100 (NZ$169 in New Zealand dollars; US$165 with an optional Capsule for listening at home), or a weekly scan membership at US$120 a month plus a one-time US$65 Capsule licence at sign-up (US$185 the first time). Complementary wellness only, not medical care.
- [Medicine Woman](https://kayjoyflowers.online/medicine-woman.html): Medicine Woman: A Path of Remembrance (digital book, US$33) and Medicine Woman: A Companion Guide, daily rituals to weave freedom into your life (US$33).
- [Frequency — The Future of Medicine](https://kayjoyflowers.online/frequency.html): Digital book (PDF and EPUB, US$33) on frequency, healing and care: science, tradition, practice and evidence, with 30 verified references.
- [The Library](https://kayjoyflowers.online/library.html): The wider catalogue of A Living Cosmology of Remembrance. Available now: Fearlessly Unfuckwithable; Medicine Woman; Frequency — The Future of Medicine. Coming soon: Energetic Alchemist; Art, the Language of the Soul; Jailbreak; Education, A New Way; The Journey to Wholeness; Who Are You?.
